message: 神のお使い

name: Paqy
message: 「Walking through the shopping district right before dusk is brutal. Delicious smells are wafting around everywhere.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sniff, sniff, sniff, this is... that and that and... the seasonings are, hm-hm...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, got it. If we leave out the meat, I can make it with the ingredients I have at home.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm counting on you! Though I kinda feel like the meat is the most important part.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's not say that」

name: Synn
message: 「...Wait, no! I came to the shopping district because I wanted to tell them about Kira-Fes!」

name: Synn
message: 「Every year, the folks in the shopping district have participated in the Charity Bazaar.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then there's no need to explain it, right? All the shopkeepers already know about it, don't they?」

name: Synn
message: 「Unlike previous years, this year it's the Kirakira Festival.」

name: Synn
message: 「I have to ask Kim-san, Tame-san, and everyone how they want to do it. And last is Auntie Shinagawa.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... So if you invite the chatty greengrocer's wife, rumors of Kira-Fes will sweep through the shopping district in no time. Just as expected of the Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... For once, I can't deny what Paqy's saying.」

name: Shio
message: 「Demon Lord, you say?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaaah!?」

name: Shio
message: 「Th-There is no need to be quite so startled, is there?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-N-N-No, it's not like that, Shio-chan, I was just... Right! I came looking for Maou Soap.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a kind of milk soap. With just this one bar, you can wash not only your body, but everything from your face and hair to even stuffed animals--it's amazing.」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm? I have never even heard of such a thing...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama, you're pushing it way too hard.」
It's your fault, Paqy!!

name: Shio
message: 「As for myself, I would still prefer to wash my hair with shampoo and conditioner, and care for my face with facial cleanser.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, that's a surprise. Doesn't the naginata brat wash her hair with lye?」

name: Shio
message: 「You fiend, I have not abandoned my womanhood!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, Shio-chan is carrying a shopping bag and all, so no matter how you look at her, she's a Girl.」

name: Shio
message: 「A-Nay. This is...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Daikon radish, carrots, napa cabbage, kabocha squash.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mandarin oranges and taro, mochi and dried squid, kelp and fish.」

name: Paqy
message: 「And refined sake to top it off, huh? Pretty old-school tastes, though... Listen, naginata girl, you shouldn't be giving up on being a woman at your age, ya know?」

name: Shio
message: 「As I said, I have not given up on anything! These goods are offerings for the shrine!」

name: Shio
message: 「I am a shrine maiden of Asukai; daily errands are also part of my training.」

name: Synn
message: 「You picked out some great ingredients. Everything looks fresh and delicious.」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, it fills me with emotion that you understand! It was well worth resigning myself to errand duty.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's a weird way to be happy about it. Don't tell me that's the only thing you can do?」

name: Shio
message: 「G-Gulp!」

name: Paqy
message: 「After they're offered up, the priests and shrine maidens eat them as blessed leftovers from the gods, right? Properly cooked, of course.」

name: Shio
message: 「G-G-Gulp!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「And yet, if you're always stuck on errand duty, that means naginata girl's cooking skills are--」

name: Shio
message: 「S-S-S-S-Synn-dono! To think I would encounter you at such an hour, in such a place--how utterly unexpected!」

name: Shio
message: 「And that noble visage brimming with ambition... Has the Charity Bazaar finally kicked off, and you are bustling about with preparations?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah.」
I won't pry any deeper, but Shio-chan really isn't very good at changing the subject, is she...

name: Shio
message: 「Is there anything I might do to be of service for the bazaar as well?」

name: Synn
message: 「This year, instead of the Charity Bazaar, we're holding Kira-Fes... the Kirakira Festival.」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm, it seems you managed to carry things forward just as you pledged.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Nothing's really taken shape yet, though, so right now we're at the stage of spreading the word about Kira-Fes to everyone.」

name: Shio
message: 「I see. So each member of the Student Council is exerting their utmost effort to inform as many people as possible.」

name: Shio
message: 「That explains why Synn-dono is not accompanied by your elder sister.」

name: Shio
message: 「Understood. Modest though my abilities may be, please allow me to lend my aid.」

name: Shio
message: 「I shall tell the shrine visitors about KiraFes」

name: Synn
message: 「That'd be a huge help, Shio-chan!」

name: Shio
message: 「It is no trouble at all」

name: Shio
message: 「Now then, I must attend to the offerings, so I shall take my leave. Please give my regards to my sister」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I'm sure Misa will be happy to hear it」

name: Shio
message: 「Hup... there!」

name: Synn
message: 「That looks heavy, let me help carry it」

name: Shio
message: 「Thank you kindly. However, something of this weight is nothing to me」

name: Shio
message: 「When my sister comes to stay over, the amount of offerings does increase, though--」

name: Synn
message: 「I bet you and Misa split them in half and carry them together then」

name: Shio
message: 「Hehe, you could tell?」

name: Shio
message: 「If the opportunity arises, please do come stay over as well, Lord Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? Y-Yeah」

name: Shio
message: 「Until next time, then」

name: Synn
message: 「She invited me out of nowhere, so it caught me by surprise」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not that there's even a shred of anything sexy about it」

name: Paqy
message: 「I mean, forget treating her like a woman, that naginata brat is still a total innocent kid」

name: Synn
message: 「Then that goes for me too, since Shio-chan and I are only a year apart」
While chatting with Paqy, I walk through the shopping district. Which shop should I talk to about KiraFes first?
